name: Views String Aggregation
description: Provides database-specific SQL string aggregation (GROUP_CONCAT / STRING_AGG) as Views aggregation functions.
provides_plugin_types: views query (Plugin/views/query: vsa_views_query_mysql, vsa_views_query_pgsql, vsa_views_query_sqlite; base class VsaBase extends core Sql)
project_description: Views String Aggregation extends Drupal Views with database-level string aggregation and concatenation. Core Views only aggregates a group into a number (COUNT/SUM/MIN/MAX/AVG); this module adds two field aggregation types, "String aggregation" and "String aggregation DISTINCT", that concatenate the values in each group into a single string using the database's native aggregate function. It detects the database backend automatically and emits the correct SQL: MySQL/MariaDB and SQLite use GROUP_CONCAT, PostgreSQL uses STRING_AGG. Per-view query settings (shown under Advanced > Other > Query settings when aggregation is enabled) let you choose the separator, an ORDER BY field and direction for the concatenated values, and, on MySQL/MariaDB, override the session group_concat_max_len. Integration is automatic: on install the module raises its module weight and, via hook_views_plugins_query_alter(), swaps the core views_query plugin class for a database-specific subclass so every aggregation-enabled view gains the new field aggregation types with no per-view wiring. This behaviour can be disabled by setting extend_views_query_plugin to FALSE, after which the query plugins (vsa_views_query_mysql / _pgsql / _sqlite) can be assigned per base table via hook_views_data(). It also ships companion Views filter and contextual-filter handlers (groupby_string) that filter on the aggregated value using HAVING clauses. Typical uses: listing all tag/term names per node, all order-item titles per order, or building flat CSV/REST exports from grouped data. Requires core Views; supports MySQL 5.7+/MariaDB 10.2+, PostgreSQL 9.1+, and SQLite 3+. Unsupported backends log a notice and fall back to plain Views behaviour.
